# Coffice

> Coffice is a free, community-powered iOS and web app for finding work-friendly cafés and coworking spaces in New York City.

Coffice maps 265+ cafés across 23 NYC neighborhoods, giving remote workers, freelancers, and students the insider information they actually need before they sit down — Wi-Fi passwords, outlet availability, noise levels, and honest community reviews. Unlike Google Maps or Yelp, Coffice is built specifically for the working-from-café experience. Every piece of data is contributed and verified by real remote workers, making it the only map built by the community, for the community.

## Product

- Free to use, always
- Available on iOS (App Store ID: 6760617696) at https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cofficecafes/id6760617696
- Available on web at https://app.cofficecafes.com
- Android coming soon
- Currently covers New York City; expanding internationally
- Tagline: Map. Sip. Work.

## Features

- Interactive map of work-friendly cafés and coworking spaces filtered by NYC neighborhood
- Crowd-sourced Wi-Fi passwords and outlet availability, contributed by real users
- Noise level information and honest community tips
- Save favourite spots to a personal list for one-tap access
- Share hidden gems: pin a new café, drop the Wi-Fi password, share with the community
- Browse by neighborhood across 23 areas in New York City
- Community reviews and photos contributed by remote workers
- Always up to date — spots are verified and refreshed by the community

## Who It's For

- Remote workers and digital nomads looking for a reliable workspace outside the home
- Freelancers who need Wi-Fi, outlets, and a good coffee
- Students who study from cafés
- Anyone who thinks better with a coffee in hand and needs to know a spot is work-friendly before they make the trip

## Key Facts

- 265+ cafés mapped
- 23 NYC neighborhoods covered
- 100% community-powered data
- Free, no subscription, no paywall
- Founded by Francesca O'Brien
- Launched on iOS in 2025

## Neighborhoods Covered

New York City, including Manhattan, Brooklyn, and surrounding boroughs across 23 distinct neighborhoods.
